Historical F1 predecessor; superseded by [A7 adoption](../notebook.qmd#working-record) on 20 October 2026.

# Question

What did the heat-including F1 fit establish relative to the other retained starts and the no-heat controls?

# Result

Among the 149-row declarations with heat, F1 had the lowest cost (32.06; pressure/species AARD 13.81/7.89%). Adding the eight Vinjarapu heats raised F1’s cost from 30.09 to 32.06 and its pressure AARD from 13.26 to 13.81%. F1 became the heat-fit record that A7 replaced.

# Basis and method

F1–F6 name the six retained fit declarations; “with heat” adds the Vinjarapu heat targets to that declaration. Objective row counts differ between declarations, so costs do not rank identical populations across every row.

# Limits and evidence type

This is predecessor calibration and assessment evidence. The historical [Cp check](../results/cp-unloaded-161/README.md) retains its original feed and proxy basis.
